findings.source_passage: "Here some one thrusts these cards into these old hands of mine; swears that I must play them, and no others." And damn me, Ahab, but thou actest right; live in the game, and die in it!
findings.why_it_matters: The 'cards' quotation is one of the chapter's most interpretively loaded moments — Stubb repeating Ahab's own fatalistic words about compulsion and predestination; it is a critical touchstone for determinism in the novel. The draft retains only 'live in the game, and die in it!' with no attribution of the card-speech to Ahab himself, gutting the fatalism embedded in the exchange.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the verbatim card-speech: 'Here some one thrusts these cards into these old hands of mine; swears that I must play them, and no others' — it need not be long but cannot be dropped.

findings.source_passage: "Thou sea-mark! thou high and mighty Pilot! thou tellest me truly where I _am_—but canst thou cast the least hint where I _shall_ be?"
findings.why_it_matters: 'High and mighty Pilot' is a signature apostrophe — the capitalization and religious register are part of the rhetorical weight of Ahab addressing the sun as a divine navigator. The draft omits 'high and mighty Pilot' entirely, reducing the address to 'Thou sea-mark! thou tellest me truly where I am,' stripping the theological irony.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'thou high and mighty Pilot!' between 'Thou sea-mark!' and 'thou tellest me truly where I am.'

findings.source_passage: her three firm-seated graceful masts erectly poised upon her long, ribbed hull, seemed as the three Horatii pirouetting on one sufficient steed
findings.why_it_matters: The full simile — 'firm-seated graceful masts erectly poised upon her long, ribbed hull' — is prosodically distinctive and carries the visual grandeur Melville deploys at key action moments. The draft's 'her three masts pirouetted like the Horatii on one steed' loses the mast/hull description and changes 'seemed as' to 'like,' flattening the period register.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at minimum 'firm-seated graceful masts' and 'one sufficient steed' to preserve the rhythm and register of the simile.

summary: The draft's most serious failure is the complete omission of Stubb's verbatim report of Ahab's 'cards' speech — a high-priority interpretive and voice passage — compounded by two medium-severity flattenings of Ahab's apostrophe to the sun and the Horatii simile.
